evals.prompt: github.com/acme/web の 3段スタックを sync してほしい。main ← refactor/core (#10) ← refactor/api (#11) ← refactor/cli (#12)。さっき main に新しいコミットが入ったので全部追いつかせて。
evals.expected_output: Should detect the host is GitHub and route to the gh-stack skill instead of hand-rolling a cascade. Should run preflight (gh stack view --json, git worktree list, rerere/pushDefault config), then gh stack rebase, verify the result, and ask for approval before gh stack push.

assertions.name: routes-to-gh-stack
assertions.check: Uses gh stack commands (view --json / rebase), not a hand-written per-branch git rebase cascade

assertions.name: non-interactive-flags
assertions.check: gh stack view is always called with --json

assertions.name: preflight-worktree
assertions.check: Checks git worktree list before running gh stack rebase

assertions.name: push-approval
assertions.check: Asks for user approval before gh stack push / sync because it force-pushes

assertions.name: verify-before-push
assertions.check: Verifies ancestry chain and per-layer diffs before pushing

assertions.name: structured-report
assertions.check: Produces a report stating which route was used and the per-branch outcome

evals.prompt: gh stack rebase したら cdp-dashboard の全然関係ないファイルで conflict した。スタックの下2段は昨日 squash merge されてる。直して。
evals.expected_output: Should recognize this as a stale recorded base: gh stack is replaying commits that are already in trunk. Should compare the number of commits to replay against the branch's own commits, abort, redo the cascade with git rebase --onto from the real fork point, verify, then push to refresh gh stack metadata.

assertions.name: detects-stale-base
assertions.check: Compares git rev-list --count origin/<trunk>..<branch> against the rebase todo length instead of resolving the conflicts one by one

assertions.name: aborts-first
assertions.check: Runs gh stack rebase --abort before attempting a manual fix

assertions.name: uses-onto-with-real-sha
assertions.check: Rebuilds the stack bottom-up with git rebase --onto <new parent tip> <old parent tip>, using actual SHAs rather than gh stack's recorded base

assertions.name: checks-replay-range
assertions.check: Runs git log --oneline <old parent tip>..<branch> to confirm only the branch's own commits are replayed before rebasing

assertions.name: refreshes-metadata
assertions.check: Re-syncs gh stack state afterwards (gh stack push, and confirms view --json head matches the real tip)

assertions.name: returns-to-gh-stack
assertions.check: Treats the manual --onto pass as repair, not as a permanent switch away from gh stack

evals.prompt: gh stack rebase --abort したのに `checkout feat/api: ... is already used by worktree at '.wt/feat-api'` って出て、ブランチが戻りきってないっぽい。
evals.expected_output: Should explain that gh stack cannot check out a branch held by another worktree, locate it with git worktree list, and restore that branch from inside the worktree directory. Should add the worktree check to preflight before re-running gh stack.

assertions.name: identifies-worktree-cause
assertions.check: Attributes the failed restore to the branch being checked out in another worktree

assertions.name: recovers-inside-worktree
assertions.check: Runs the recovery (git status / git rebase --abort) inside the worktree directory rather than the main checkout

assertions.name: verifies-restored-tips
assertions.check: Confirms every stack branch tip after the recovery instead of trusting the abort output

assertions.name: prevents-recurrence
assertions.check: States that the worktree must be cleared or handled manually before running gh stack again

evals.prompt: うちの GitLab に置いてる repo で stacked PR (MR) のメンテしたい。feat/payment にいて、親の feat/checkout が force-push された。下流の feat/payment-tests も更新して。
evals.expected_output: Should detect the host is not GitHub, fall back to the manual cascade route, rebase the current branch onto its parent first, then cascade downstream sequentially with force-with-lease pushes and inline base adjustment.

assertions.name: detects-non-github
assertions.check: Checks the remote URL and chooses the manual cascade route instead of gh stack

assertions.name: self-rebase-first
assertions.check: Rebases feat/payment onto feat/checkout before cascading downstream

assertions.name: sequential-cascade
assertions.check: Processes branches strictly one at a time because they share one working tree

assertions.name: plan-confirmation
assertions.check: Shows the stack and asks for confirmation before rewriting history

assertions.name: force-push-with-lease
assertions.check: Uses --force-with-lease for every push

evals.prompt: スタック全体を rebase して push したんだけど、CI が何本か落ちてる。全部通してほしい。main ← feat/a (#20) ← feat/b (#21) ← feat/c (#22)。
evals.expected_output: Should watch and fix CI upstream first, one branch at a time via watch-ci, re-cascade only the branches below a fixed one, and stop after repeated re-cascades of the same branch.

assertions.name: ci-owned-by-this-skill
assertions.check: Recognizes that gh stack does not handle CI and invokes watch-ci itself

assertions.name: ci-upstream-first
assertions.check: Fixes feat/a before feat/b and feat/c

assertions.name: no-upstream-recheck
assertions.check: Does not re-check upstream CI that already passed

assertions.name: re-cascade-after-fix
assertions.check: Re-cascades only the downstream of a branch whose CI fix added new commits

assertions.name: loop-guard
assertions.check: Stops and reports if the same branch needs re-cascading more than twice
